sources.title: qwq-plus model information (indexed October 10, 2026 version)
sources.evidence: Complete indexed primary page identifies the Qwen2.5-based reasoning model and documents text input/output, 131072-token context, and Function Calling supported in Beijing but unsupported in Singapore. Direct opening now redirects to the general model-selection page; these are last-documented specifications, not proof of current endpoint operation.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Live release table explicitly lists qwq-plus on 2025-03-05 in both international and mainland sections, describing Qwen2.5-based reinforcement-learning reasoning with mathematics and coding capabilities.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Later first-party comparison tables report Dense architecture and nominal 32B total/activated parameters for the column explicitly named QwQ-32B. The report contains no QwQ-Plus entry or hosted-to-checkpoint identity mapping, so these counts cannot establish this endpoint's size.

sources.title: Qwen/QwQ-32B model card
sources.evidence: The released QwQ-32B checkpoint card states 32.5B parameters and Apache-2.0, but does not map qwq-plus to that checkpoint. Its weights, license, parameter count and architecture cannot be transferred to QwQ-Plus.

sources.title: QwenLM/QwQ
sources.evidence: Official repository identifies QwQ as the reasoning-model series developed by the Qwen team at Alibaba Cloud; the reviewed repository does not name qwq-plus or establish its equivalence to a released checkpoint.

sources.title: Notice on the Postponed Retirement of Selected Legacy Models
sources.evidence: July 6, 2026 primary notice explicitly includes qwq-plus among legacy mainline models scheduled to cease service October 10, 2026, subject to actual change time. This establishes the announced retirement, not a successful API availability test.

sources.title: Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 model card
sources.evidence: Reviewed this later first-party reasoning-model card for comparison disclosures; it contains no QwQ-Plus column or endpoint-to-checkpoint mapping.

name.note: Readable display form of the exact official identifier qwq-plus.

developer.note: QwQ is developed by Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team.

family.note: Official release description places the model in the Qwen QwQ series.

release_date.note: Explicit release-table date for qwq-plus in both regional sections.

open_weights.note: No exact first-party closed-weights declaration or mapping to a released checkpoint was verified. API availability alone cannot establish false; the QwQ-32B release cannot establish true.

license.note: No model-weight license was verified for this exact endpoint. QwQ-32B's Apache-2.0 license is not transferable without an identity mapping.

parameters_b.note: Reviewed exact endpoint documentation and later first-party comparison material; none discloses this identifier's total count. QwQ-32B's labeled counts are excluded because identity was not established.

active_parameters_b.note: No activated count for QwQ-Plus in reviewed primary sources. The later QwQ-32B column is a different identifier.

architecture.note: Qwen2.5 derivation is documented, but it does not identify the exact base checkpoint or establish dense versus MoE for this hosted variant.

context_window.note: Exact token limit in the complete indexed primary model page; last documented before its redirect.

modalities.note: Both regional capability tables document text input and output.

reasoning.note: Release table explicitly classifies the exact model as reasoning.

tool_call.note: Supported in Beijing; unsupported in Singapore. True records documented model capability with this regional qualification.

description.value: Qwen reasoning model for deliberate problem solving, math, and coding
description.note: Faithful concise characterization; no unsupported parameter, architecture or performance-ranking claim.

patch.notes: QwQ-Plus has no verified mapping to the released QwQ-32B checkpoint. Weight openness remains unverified; total/active parameters and architecture are undisclosed in the reviewed exact-model sources. Function Calling was documented for Beijing but not Singapore. Context and modality values are last-documented specifications from the indexed October 10, 2026 model page, which now redirects. Alibaba announced October 10, 2026 retirement; current endpoint operation was not tested.

sources.label: Qwen3 technical report: distinct QwQ-32B comparison column

summary: Confirmed name/developer/family, explicit March 5, 2025 release, reasoning description and last-documented context/modalities. Qualified tool calling by region. Cleared unsupported closed-weights assertion. Total count, active count and architecture remain null: later primary comparison tables name QwQ-32B and provide no QwQ-Plus identity mapping. Recorded announced October 10, 2026 retirement and the exact model page's redirect without claiming a live endpoint test.
